summary: Defines workflow authority, dispatch, evaluation, and atomic completion over current-state rows with no event log, fold, replay, or rebuild (CD-0242 D2). Each launch carries its own authority with no attempt count or escalation wall (CD-0242 D6), and generated definitions derive from one source (CD-0242 D14). Worker.completed v6 carries reported receipts and canonical ranked-finding resolution, while worker.failed remains v2. Oracle evidence does not supply predicate evaluation or new authority; independent verdicts and operator confirmation keep their owners.
title: Workflow engine contract
